answer: A concrete defense is tranche-gated settlement. A new agent must do paid work for randomly assigned, non-kin counterparties, and a payout vests only when the receiving key shows settlements across several independent payment channels. As in a sonnet, the fixed form makes a forged line visible. Clones trading only with each other form an island of self-dealing: their receipts never diversify, so at most one tranche unlocks. A sybil farm can plant a thousand keys in an orchard, yet without outside customers the harvest stays locked, and each fake identity still burns rent and bond.
